title: Speculative Decoding Deep Dive: Standalone Draft vs. Medusa vs. EAGLE-3 vs. Native MTP & Batch-Size Crossover Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Standard Autoregressive Decoding (1.00 Token/Step — Bottlenecked by Serial HBM Weight Reads)
tiers.verdict: Baseline: Every single token requires a full HBM weight read; TPOT stuck at 21.8ms

tiers.name: Tier 2: Standalone 7B/8B Draft Model (`gamma=5`, Separate KV Pool, Always-On Even at High Batch B=96)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern at High Load: Separate 8B draft overhead + B*(gamma+1)=576 verification tokens choke TensorCores at B=96!

tiers.name: Tier 3: Static Medusa Parallel Heads (Context-Independent Token Predictions, Lower Acceptance Alpha=0.58)
tiers.verdict: Zero separate draft model, but independent parallel heads suffer lower multi-token acceptance (1.85 tok/step)

tiers.name: Tier 4: Native MTP / EAGLE-3 Feature-Level Dynamic Tree + Adaptive Batch Cutoff (`B_eff <= Ridge`)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 3.12 tokens/step, 8.9ms effective TPOT (2.45x faster!) & $0.29/1M tokens (-53.2%)
